# GraphQL counters (.graphql, .graphqls, .gql: a schema in SDL or executable operations), for a rule
# with the prompt file-body-contract: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line
# blanks # comments, block strings ("""...""", descriptions) and strings, leftmost region first, so a
# "type" in a description does not count; a string that is never closed runs to the end of its line,
# a block string to the end of the
# file. It also blanks the body of a schema definition (schema { query: Query }, extend schema too;
# its directives stay), whose root operations are no fields. A definition counts at the start of a
# line, an extension (extend type) too; "object types"
# leaves out the root types Query, Mutation and Subscription, which have a counter of their own.
# "fields (approx)" counts a name at the start of an indented line followed by its arguments and a
# colon (the fields of types, interfaces and input types; an alias in an operation too), arguments
# with one level of nested parentheses (a directive on an argument) included; "directive
# uses" every @name that is not the directive's own definition; "operations" and "fragments" count at
# column 0, where an executable document defines them. ContractFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
[ignore] comments, descriptions, strings and the schema definition
object types
root operation types
interfaces
unions
enums
input types
scalars
fields (approx)
directive definitions
directive uses
deprecated fields and values
operations
fragments
